title: Experiences Integrating Database Support into the OLCF Test Harness
problem: HPC system testing frameworks lack database integration for real-time monitoring and advanced analysis on leadership-class supercomputers.
motivation: Frontier and other leadership systems require comprehensive testing of 9000+ nodes with efficient monitoring and root-cause analysis.
method: OLCF Test Harness (OTH) v3.0/3.1 integrates InfluxDB, Apache Kafka, Apache Druid, and Grafana for database-backed testing.
key_novelty: First explicit database-backed testing framework for leadership-class HPC systems
limitations: Operational framework paper; limited novel algorithmic or architectural contributions.
